text:
sarah.h: Quick sync — PriceSleuth trial ends next Friday. Need clarifications on their billing model before we decide on a 12mo commit. Can someone pull the invoice samples?
ben: I pulled the trial usage report earlier. Short version: they meter gen tokens and embeddings separately, plus a per-request API call fee for streaming.
aseem: @ben can you paste the mapping? we need to map to our cost dashboard SKU names.
ben: Here are the lines from their trial invoice (sanitized):
```
PRICE-SLEUTH GEN-TOKENS: 1,240,512 tokens @ $0.0009/token = $1,116.46
PRICE-SLEUTH EMBEDS: 34,200 vectors @ $0.0025/vector = $85.50
PRICE-SLEUTH STREAM-FEE: 2,300 calls @ $0.01/call = $23.00
TOTAL = $1,224.96
```
marta: Looks reasonable. Two asks from finance: 1) can they issue Net30 invoices with PO? 2) do they support cost center tags on invoices (we need cost allocation fields).
priya (PriceSleuth): Hi all — happy to help. Short answers: we support Net30 and PO numbers on invoices. For tagging, we can add a free-text "cost_center" field to the invoice metadata; fed to accounting as a line-item attribute.
ben: Are there commit discounts if we do 12 months? Also curious about a min-commit vs. overage model.
priya (PriceSleuth): Yes — our standard offer: 15% off list for a 12-month committed spend >= $60k ARR, 22% off for >= $150k. Commits are monthly billed, with true-ups quarterly. Overage is at list rate with a 10% cap year-over-year (we won't increase overage rate by >10% mid-term).
aseem: How do they define "tokens" — do we need to pre-process? We saw discrepancies vs our tokenization tool.
priya (PriceSleuth): We use a BPE tokenizer similar to GPT-style. We can provide a tokenization example and a small script to reproduce counts. If you prefer, we can accept Redwood's token counts for billing reconciliation (requires signing the reconciliation addendum).
sarah.h: That reconciliation addendum sounds important. @marta — would finance sign that?
marta: Potentially. Need legal + procurement review. Also need tax/VAT behavior — do they net VAT on invoices to EU entities?
priya (PriceSleuth): For EU customers with VAT IDs, we reverse-charge; otherwise we add local VAT. We'll include tax summary on each invoice.
ben: Two more practical items: 1) trial credit carryover? we used $3k trial credits. Do those apply to commit? 2) Do they offer a usage cap to prevent surprise charges?
priya (PriceSleuth): Trial credits do not count toward commit minimums, but we can apply remaining trial credit as a one-time invoice credit when you convert. We also offer a soft-usage cap at the account level you can set; hard caps can be done but require us to enable a throttling rule (can impact latency).
aseem: Any SLA/uptime + regional redundancy for Dedicated customers? This matters for Dedicated vs hosted debate.
priya (PriceSleuth): For Hosted: 99.9% SLA on monthly uptime. For Dedicated (reserved pool) we offer 99.95% with optional regional redundancy add-on.
sarah.h: Procurement nit: pricing table format they sent yesterday is a bit messy for procurement ingestion. Can we ask them for a machine-readable price sheet (CSV) with SKU ids?
priya (PriceSleuth): Absolutely. I'll attach a CSV with SKU, unit, unit_price, tier thresholds, currency.
procure-bot: Reminder: Vendor risk questionnaire pending — PriceSleuth sent DOCS link (https://pricesleuth.com/risk-form). Assigned to @marta and @legal-team. Due in 7 days.
marta: Noted. Legal will triage.<:thumbsup:>
sarah.h: Ok next steps: (1) @priya please share CSV + tokenization script, (2) @priya confirm PO/Net30 + invoice tagging in writing, (3) @marta/finance to review reconciliation addendum and vendor risk form. If commit math looks good we'll ask for a draft SOW with discounts baked in.
priya (PriceSleuth): Will do — I'll upload CSV and token script today and send a formal quote with the 15% 12mo discount option.
ben: If legal approves reconciliation addendum we can automate our billing ingestion. :eyes:
sarah.h: Thanks everyone. If we get the CSV today I can run a quick cost projection against our last 60 days and post results here before end of day.
